# Refund Policy

## Eligibility window

Acme Widgets accepts refund requests within 14 calendar days of delivery.
Requests submitted after day 14 are declined automatically unless the
widget arrived defective, in which case the product/defect policy applies
instead and there is no time limit tied to the refund window.

## Partial refunds

If a customer returns only part of a multi-widget order, Acme issues a
partial refund equal to the per-unit price of the returned widgets, minus a
10% restocking fee. Restocking fees are waived when the return reason is
"wrong item shipped" or "damaged in transit" - those go through the
shipping/damaged process, not this one.

## Refund timelines

Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7
business days of Acme receiving the returned widget at the warehouse.
Store credit refunds, when the customer opts for them instead of a
cash refund, post within 24 hours. If a customer reports that more than 10
business days have passed since the warehouse confirmed receipt of the
return and no refund has appeared, escalate to L2 billing - that is outside
the normal timeline and usually means the refund failed silently on the
payment processor's side.

## What counts as "received"

A refund clock starts when the warehouse scans the returned package in,
not when the customer ships it. Tracking showing "delivered" to the
warehouse address is not the same as a warehouse scan; if a customer cites
carrier tracking as proof of return but the refund hasn't started, tell
them the warehouse scan can lag carrier delivery by up to 2 business days
before it's worth escalating.
